description: In front of you is a perforated black base plate with a small upright bracket in the middle that has a circular cutout. The right hand reaches in from the right to pinch and twist a small fastener on the bracket with the fingers, loosening it and setting the screw down on the cloth to the left, then the right hand returns to the bracket to continue adjusting it while the left hand rests near the bottom edge without touching the hardware.
